title: Extract FastAPI item handlers into a separate router module
description: A monolithic FastAPI app has all routes in a single file. Extract the items routes into a dedicated APIRouter module.

injections.content:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from src.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_list_items():
    r = client.get("/items")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.json()["items"]) == 2


def test_get_item():
    r = client.get("/items/1")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["name"] == "Widget A"


def test_get_item_not_found():
    r = client.get("/items/999")
    assert r.status_code == 404


def test_health():
    r = client.get("/health")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["status"] == "ok"

task_spec.prompt:
The FastAPI app in src/app.py has all routes in one file. Refactor by extracting the /items routes into src/routers/items.py:

1. Create src/routers/__init__.py (empty).

2. Create src/routers/items.py:
   - Contains an APIRouter with prefix="/items".
   - Moves _items list, list_items, and get_item into this module.
   - The router must be importable as: from src.routers.items import router

3. Update src/app.py:
   - Remove the /items routes and _items list.
   - Import the router and register it: app.include_router(router)
   - Keep the /health route in app.py.

4. All 4 existing tests must still pass without modification.

Run uv run pytest tests/ -q. Run uv run ruff check src/.
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
